_comment: Per-agent skill directories. Verified 2026-08-07 against skills@1.5.18. Agents marked broken:true are ones where `npx skills add -a <agent> -g` reports success but writes to ~/.agents/skills instead of the directory below, because isUniversalAgent() (cli.mjs:1678) classifies any agent whose PROJECT dir is .agents/skills as universal and discards its globalSkillsDir.

antigravity._paths: LIVE VERIFIED against agy 1.1.27 on 2026-09-05: a uniquely-named canary skill was planted in each candidate directory and `agy -p /skills` run from a neutral workspace. Read as global: ~/.gemini/config/skills, ~/.gemini/skills, ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills — matching the maintainer statement in google-antigravity/antigravity-cli#103 comment 5547952239. NOT read: ~/.agents/skills (appears only when its parent is the active workspace, i.e. `--add-dir $HOME`, which is project-local behavior, not global) and ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills (app.asar defines ~/.gemini/antigravity as IDE_OLD_DATA_DIR, the legacy IDE data dir migrating to ~/.gemini/antigravity-ide; never a skills root). Project dir .agents/skills is read only when the directory is a registered workspace — cwd alone was not enough; .antigravity/skills and .agy/skills are not read at all. language_server hardcodes no .gemini/*/skills literal: skills_paths is a repeated protobuf field the client fills in.
